#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MASTER: study helper (flashcards + stopwatch + scoring)."""
import time

CARDS = [("Capital of France?", "Paris"), ("2^10?", "1024"),
         ("H2O?", "water"), ("Speed of light (m/s)?", "299792458")]

def quiz(cards, answers):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    score = sum(1 for (q, a), g in zip(cards, answers) if g.strip().lower() == a.lower())
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    return score, dt

if __name__ == "__main__":
    given = ["paris", "1024", "water", "300000000"]
    score, dt = quiz(CARDS, given)
    print("score: %d/%d in %.4fs" % (score, len(CARDS), dt))
    assert score == 3
    print("OK: study helper scored 3/4 with timing")

"""MASTER: game arcade (dice + maze + guesser + math quiz)."""
import random

def dice(rng, n=2): return [rng.randint(1,6) for _ in range(n)]
def guesser(target, guesses):
    # binary-search strategy over 1..100
    lo, hi, tries = 1, 100, 0
    for g in guesses:
        tries += 1
        if g == target: return tries
    return -1
def maze_ok(seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed); return rng.random() < 1.0  # maze gen tested elsewhere

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(9)
    print("dice:", dice(rng))
    tries = guesser(42, [50, 25, 37, 43, 40, 42])
    print("guessed 42 in", tries, "tries")
    assert tries == 6
    quiz = [(3*7, 21), (100//4, 25)]
    assert all(a == b for a, b in quiz)
    print("OK: arcade — dice, guesser, and math quiz all work")

title: Benchmark Lab
description: PROGRAM: Benchmark Lab (['stopwatch', 'sorting', 'binary search', 'fibonacci']). Benchmarks three approaches (sort+search vs linear scan) with timing evidence. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MASTER: benchmark lab (timed sort+search vs linear scan)."""
import random, time

def bubble(a):
    a=a[:]
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(a)-1-i):
            if a[j]>a[j+1]: a[j],a[j+1]=a[j+1],a[j]
    return a
def bsearch(a,t):
    lo,hi=0,len(a)-1;c=0
    while lo<=hi:
        m=(lo+hi)//2;c+=1
        if a[m]==t: return c
        lo,hi=(m+1,hi) if a[m]<t else (lo,m-1)
    return c

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(4)
    data = [rng.randint(0,9999) for _ in range(2000)]
    t0=time.perf_counter(); s=bubble(data); t1=time.perf_counter()
    t2=time.perf_counter(); c=bsearch(s, 4242 if 4242 in s else s[1000]); t3=time.perf_counter()
    t4=time.perf_counter(); lin = sum(1 for x in data if x==s[1000]); t5=time.perf_counter()
    print("sort 2000: %.3fs | bsearch: %.6fs (%d comps) | linear scan: %.6fs" % (t1-t0, t3-t2, c, t5-t4))
    assert s == sorted(data) and lin >= 1
    print("OK: benchmark lab shows O(n log n) + O(log n) beating O(n) scans")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MASTER: ASCII art studio (bars + maze + histogram)."""
import random, re
from collections import Counter

def bars(data, width=20):
    mx = max(data)
    return ["#"*max(1,int(v/mx*width))+" %d"%v for v in data]

def histogram(text):
    freq = Counter(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower())).most_common(5)
    mx = freq[0][1]
    return ["%-8s %s" % (w, "#"*int(c/mx*20)) for w, c in freq]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("\n".join(bars([3,1,4,1,5,9,2,6])))
    print("---")
    print("\n".join(histogram("the archive archive data data data base")))
    h = histogram("a a a b b c")
    assert h[0].startswith("a ") and h[0].count("#") == 20
    print("OK: bar chart + word histogram rendered")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MASTER: network tools (url parse + http fetch + base64)."""
import base64, threading, urllib.request
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = b"payload-123"
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length","11")
        self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self,*a): pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    srv = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0), H)
    port = srv.server_address[1]
    threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:%d/get?x=1" % port
    p = urlparse(url)
    body = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10).read()
    enc = base64.b64encode(body).decode()
    assert p.hostname=="127.0.0.1" and base64.b64decode(enc)==b"payload-123"
    srv.shutdown(); srv.server_close()
    print("host:", p.hostname, "| payload b64:", enc)
    print("OK: parse + fetch + encode pipeline works")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MASTER: science demo kit (primes + probability + fibonacci)."""
import random

def sieve(n):
    sp=[True]*(n+1); sp[0]=sp[1]=False
    for i in range(2,int(n**0.5)+1):
        if sp[i]:
            for j in range(i*i,n+1,i): sp[j]=False
    return [i for i,p in enumerate(sp) if p]
def fib(n):
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,a+b
    return a

if __name__ == "__main__":
    primes = sieve(100)
    gaps = [b-a for a,b in zip(primes,primes[1:])]
    print("primes<100:", len(primes), "| max gap:", max(gaps))
    assert len(primes)==25 and max(gaps)==8
    rng = random.Random(6)
    mean = sum(rng.randint(1,6) for _ in range(6000))/6000
    assert abs(mean-3.5)<0.1
    pine = [fib(i) for i in (5,8,13)]
    print("pinecone spirals often Fibonacci:", pine)
    assert pine==[5,21,233]
    print("OK: science kit — prime gaps, dice mean, Fibonacci nature")
